name: Prince Naveen's Cajun Charcuterie Board
whyItWorks: Aged cheeses and thinly sliced cured meats offer low-fiber protein, but spicy Cajun links, whole-grain mustard seeds, and pickled garnishes require careful picking.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Stick to the mild aged cheeses, plain sliced prosciutto/ham, and refined bread/crackers. Leave the spicy Cajun sausage, whole-seed mustard, and pickled vegetables on the board.
